Hite-Rite — Quick adjusting saddle locator (US 4,580,835)

Filed and granted under the plain title ‘Quick adjusting saddle locator,’ with Josh Angell named first and Joe Breeze — builder of the first purpose-built mountain bike — second. Not a dropper post…
